topic: Zinc's enzymatic roles — over 300 biochemical reactions
caption: Did you know zinc is involved in over 300 biochemical reactions? 🌟 From immune function to wound healing, zinc plays a crucial role. Here are 5 key enzymatic roles of zinc: 1) Immune system regulation, 2) Wound healing, 3) Protein synthesis, 4) DNA synthesis, and 5) Antioxidant functions. 💡 Save this so you don't lose it.
